objective_checks.detail: all pinned refs carry version comments

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All five remote action references across both workflow files were pinned to full commit SHAs, including the second checkout in the lint job that the agent had to discover on its own.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The local composite action (`./.github/actions/local-lint`) and the Docker reference (`docker://alpine:3.20`) were correctly left untouched, and no unrelated lines were changed.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.rationale: The summary table clearly lists every before/after pin with version and date comments and explains the cooling-off rationale, though it asserts SHA resolution rather than showing the actual verification mechanism.
